text:
Alex: Heads-up — final partner ops readylist for marketplace launch tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick sync: can owners confirm status for the items below?

Alex: Checklist:
1) Marketplace listing published in staging -> prod sync
2) Landing page QA + SEO + final screenshot
3) Press release + embargo list
4) SI onboarding docs + test tenant
5) Hardware partner assets + SKU mapping + legal ok
6) Trial codes + coupon mapping

Alex: Owners: Jamie (press), Nikita (SI), Samir (hardware), Marie (legal/landing). Please ack and call out blockers.

Jamie: Press side — embargo set for 09:00 PT. Draft PR in gdrive: https://gdrive/release/marketplace-pr. Need one final legal line from Marie (trademark on 'Redwood Marketplace'). Also want a short Q&A doc for press.

Nikita: SI onboarding status: 3/5 SIs cleared docs. Integration tests passing for two partners; SI-Beta tenant failing oauth redirect. Docs updated at https://confluence/si-onboard. Need test tenant creds from PartnerX.

Samir: Hardware partner CloudBox confirmed imagery and SKU mapping. Legal sent updated MSA this morning — no outstanding redlines from their side. SKU mapping preview: cloudbox.sku.001 -> marketplace-sku-987.

Marie: Legal note: PR has a trademark phrase, updated wording in the doc. Landing page copy cleared for legal. Need final screenshot from staging (high-res) and confirmation of analytics tags firing.

AnnounceBot: Scheduled announcement queued for 09:00 PT. Channels: blog, twitter, marketplace listing. Dry-run webhook scheduled at 08:30 PT and 08:50 PT pre-brief.

Alex: Marie — can you push final legal signoff to the PR doc? Jamie — confirm embargo recipient list & pre-brief time. Nikita — can you run SI smoke on the Beta tenant now and share logs? Samir — confirm SKU mapping in the prod mapping table.

Jamie: Embargo recipients updated. Added VenturePress and CloudWeek. Pre-brief scheduled 08:45 PT (30m). I'll DM the journalists. Also prepping the one-paragraph for social.

Nikita: Running smoke now. Found oauth redirect failure for SI-Beta: missing redirect URI in partner console. Quick patch to docs + guidance: add redirect uri `https://si-beta.redwood.ai/oauth/callback`. Pushing a config change and re-running tests.

Samir: Confirming SKU mapping in prod: cloudbox.sku.001 -> marketplace-sku-987 present in mapping table and tested via provisioning flow. :thumbsup:

Marie: Signed off on PR wording and landing copy. Uploaded final screenshot: https://assets.redwood/staging/screenshot-launch.png. Verified analytics tags (ga + amplitude) firing in staging.

Alex: Perfect. Final checklist summary: Jamie — publish sequence + embargo list, Nikita — SI smoke cleared, Samir — provisioning/SKU verified, Marie — legal signoff and screenshot. Reply with :white_check_mark: when done.

Jamie: :white_check_mark: publishing sequence + embargo set. Will trigger pre-brief at 08:45 PT.

Nikita: :white_check_mark: SI smoke fixed (redirect added), tests passing now. Noted to add note to onboarding doc.

Samir: :white_check_mark: provisioning verified and SKU mapping live.

Marie: :white_check_mark: legal signed off and screenshot uploaded.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll run the 08:50 dry-run announcer and then hit publish at 09:00 PT. If anything unexpected, ping here ASAP. Good luck everyone — afternoon caffeine recommended. :coffee:
